title: Anyone can re-initialize the `swapProxy`
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description The `SwapImpl::initialize` function lacks access control and can be successfully invoked more than once, allowing arbitrary reinitialization of the proxy. This enables an attacker to update critical state variables, such as the `router` and `permit2` addresses, with custom malicious contracts. Doing so can allow an attacker to steal all `ETH` and `WETH` that gets sent to the `RoyaltyManager`.
